verdict.rationale: WezTerm's own docs list Searchable Scrollback with Ctrl-Shift-F to enter search mode and Shift-PageUp/PageDown to move through scrollback, so the core search capability is first-party. Shell integration also lets you jump through scrollback to the start of earlier commands, but that is command-level navigation, not moving between search matches. Missing for 10: documented next/previous-match navigation within search mode, evidence on search speed with large scrollback, and independent hands-on corroboration of the search workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search my scrollback quickly and jump between matches
